skill.name: track-management
skill.description: Create, plan, review, and complete Conductor tracks for features, bugs, chores, and refactors.
skill.summary: Guides Conductor track creation, planning, status tracking, and completion workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Track work can become unclear when specs, plans, status, and metadata drift apart. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured guidance for Conductor track workflows.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to create feature, bug, chore, and refactor tracks.
Provides structured guidance for spec.md requirements and acceptance criteria.
Explains phased plan.md task breakdowns with verification steps.
Documents track status markers for pending, active, blocked, skipped, and complete tasks.
Describes tracks.md registry entries and metadata fields.
Offers common phase patterns for feature, bug fix, and refactor work.
limitations: It provides workflow guidance and does not execute Conductor commands directly.
It assumes the project uses the documented Conductor file conventions.
It does not replace product, technical, or security review of the planned work.
It does not automatically validate repository state or commit history.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Feature Track
use_cases.description: Create a scoped specification and phased plan before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Bug Fix Work
use_cases.description: Turn a defect report into reproduction, fix, and verification phases with clear status markers.

use_cases.title: Review Track Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether requirements, dependencies, risks, tasks, and acceptance criteria are complete.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Conductor track for this work: [describe the feature, bug, chore, or refactor]. Include scope, acceptance criteria, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this approved spec into a phased plan.md with tasks, verification steps, status markers, and checkpoint placeholders: [paste spec summary].

prompt_templates.title: Review Track Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this track for missing requirements, unclear scope, weak acceptance criteria, dependency gaps, and plan completeness: [paste track details].

prompt_templates.title: Manage Track Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the track workflow after this implementation progress: [describe completed tasks, blocked tasks, commits, and verification results]. Recommend next actions.

output_examples.input: Create a feature track for passwordless login.
output: Scope includes login initiation, token delivery, verification, session creation, and acceptance criteria.
Plan phases cover foundation, core authentication flow, integration, and final verification.

output_examples.input: Review my plan for a bug fix track.
output: The plan includes reproduction and fix phases, but acceptance criteria are not testable enough.
Add a regression test task, document affected flows, and define manual verification steps.
Mark the blocked API dependency before implementation starts.

output_examples.input: Summarize the current status of an active refactor track.
output: Phase one is complete with characterization tests recorded.
Phase two is active and has one blocked task waiting for review.
Next action is to resolve the blocked task before cleanup begins.

best_practices: Keep each track focused on one logical change with clear scope boundaries.
Write acceptance criteria before building the phased implementation plan.
Update status markers and commit references as soon as work changes state.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated features, fixes, and refactors in one track.
Do not start implementation from a plan with unresolved core requirements.
Do not mark tasks complete without matching verification evidence.

faq.question: What is a Conductor track?
faq.answer: A Conductor track is a logical work unit with a specification, phased plan, status metadata, and registry entry.

faq.question: Can this skill create files automatically?
faq.answer: The skill provides guidance for creating track files. File creation depends on the tool and user workflow.

faq.question: Which track types does it support?
faq.answer: It covers feature, bug, chore, and refactor tracks, with guidance for each type.

faq.question: Does it support track completion?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to verify acceptance criteria, update documentation, mark status, and archive completed work.

faq.question: Does it run shell commands?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill content is Markdown guidance and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Can teams use it for reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. Teams can use it to review requirements, plans, dependencies, risks, and status before implementation.
